subject: Re: Kickoff: Project Nimbus (BBF productization)
body:
Ulla,

Staffing and compute picture. People: Wei 80%, Freya 60%, Yara 50%, Halima 50% through May. That covers the repro sweep and the config cleanup, but not much slack.

Compute: BBF at replay ratio 8 is cheap per-run but the sweep isn't - 26 Atari 100k games x 5 seeds x 3 agents (BBF, SPR, SR-SPR) is roughly 390 runs. I want 64 A100s on titan-a100 best-effort through April; that pool is shared so no reservation needed, but Ines, flagging in case there's contention.

One dependency: JAX/CUDA version pinning has bitten us before on titan images - Halima will bake a container so we're not debugging installs across the fleet.

If we clear M1 by Apr 3 as planned, I'd like a decision by mid-April on whether M3 demo targets a live-training demo or canned checkpoints.

Ivo
